description: Source code for Ethernet driver for NXP S32 NetC switch in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, port configuration, PHY link handling, and switch setup.

methods.name: nxp_s32_eth_configure_port
methods.description: Configures Ethernet port with specified speed and duplex mode.

methods.name: phy_link_state_changed
methods.description: Callback for PHY link state changes, updates port configuration and carrier status.

methods.name: nxp_s32_eth_configure_cgm
methods.description: Configures clock gating for Ethernet port based on port index.

methods.name: nxp_s32_eth_initialize
methods.description: Initializes Ethernet device, applies pinctrl, configures clock gating, and calls common init.

methods.name: nxp_s32_eth_iface_init
methods.description: Initializes network interface, sets MAC address, PHY callback, and enables MSI-X channels.
